note.body:
Hi James,

We're excited to welcome Sarah Chen to the team as a Senior Software Engineer in the platform group. She starts in 7 days on 2026-06-21 (within 2 weeks).

The introductory meeting with Sarah is scheduled for June 22 at 2:00 PM for 30 minutes.

I'd suggest Tom Brennan as her onboarding buddy. With 2.8 years at the company and expertise in platform infrastructure, Tom could be a great fit for guiding Sarah.

Attached is a draft of the 30-60-90 day plan. This is a starting point for you to adjust and refine as needed before sharing it with Sarah.

Please also review the manager prep checklist below to help you get everything ready for her arrival.

Best,

The Onboarding Team

thirty_days: Complete onboarding with all tools: GitHub, Slack, PagerDuty, Datadog.
Review and push a small code change to a low-risk module, getting it code-reviewed by a peer.
Meet one-on-one with each team member to understand their roles and current projects.
sixty_days: Lead a review session on a current codebase process, proposing at least one improvement.
Deliver a small feature enhancement for the platform with successful deployment and documentation.
Collaborate on an incident response drill with Amy Zhao to learn the team's incident protocols.
ninety_days: Take ownership of a medium-complexity feature, coordinating with cross-functional teams for delivery.
Lead a platform reliability improvement meeting, drawing on insights from observability tools.
Develop a proposal for a new platform tooling initiative based on identified gaps.

manager_checklist: Review Sarah Chen's resume and portfolio to understand her past work and skills.
Familiarize with the team's current projects and any upcoming deadlines.
Prepare initial talking points for the intro meeting discussing team culture and expectations.
Ensure all IT hardware and software provisioning is complete before her start date.
Plan the first project Sarah will tackle to align with her 30-60-90 day plan.
Set up relevant permissions in AWS Console once access is approved.

details.subject_line: Welcome to the Platform Team, Sarah!
details.body:
Hi Sarah,

Welcome to the Platform Team! We’re thrilled to have you join us as a Senior Software Engineer. Your onboarding buddy, Tom Brennan, will reach out soon to help you settle in and ensure you have everything you need.

On your first day, your MacBook Pro will be set up and ready for you. You’ll also get access to essential tools like GitHub Enterprise, Slack (including our engineering channels), and PagerDuty. Plus, there's an intro meeting with your manager on June 22nd to discuss your role and answer any questions.

We’re excited to see the amazing work you’ll do here. Looking forward to seeing you soon!

Best,
The Platform Team

note.body:
Hi James,

We're excited to welcome Sarah Chen to the team as a Senior Software Engineer in the platform group. She starts in 7 days on 2026-06-21 (within 2 weeks).

The introductory meeting with Sarah is scheduled for June 22 at 2:00 PM for 30 minutes.

I'd suggest Tom Brennan as her onboarding buddy. With 2.8 years at the company and expertise in platform infrastructure, Tom could be a great fit for guiding Sarah.

Attached is a draft of the 30-60-90 day plan. This is a starting point for you to adjust and refine as needed before sharing it with Sarah.

Please also review the manager prep checklist below to help you get everything ready for her arrival.

Best,

The Onboarding Team

details.subject_line: Welcome to the Platform Team, Sarah!
details.body:
Hi Sarah,

Welcome to the Platform Team! We’re thrilled to have you join us as a Senior Software Engineer. Your onboarding buddy, Tom Brennan, will reach out soon to help you settle in and ensure you have everything you need.

On your first day, your MacBook Pro will be set up and ready for you. You’ll also get access to essential tools like GitHub Enterprise, Slack (including our engineering channels), and PagerDuty. Plus, there's an intro meeting with your manager on June 22nd to discuss your role and answer any questions.

We’re excited to see the amazing work you’ll do here. Looking forward to seeing you soon!

Best,
The Platform Team
